name: Soyuz-2
tagline: Modern Soyuz workhorse — carries Soyuz MS crew + Progress MS cargo to the ISS
description: RKTs Progress's modernised Soyuz family, with digital flight controls replacing the analogue systems of Soyuz-FG / Soyuz-U. Variants 2.1a (RD-107A/RD-108A first stage + RD-0124 third stage), 2.1b (uprated third stage), and 2.1v (no boosters, single RD-110 stage). Carries every modern Russian crewed and cargo flight to the ISS plus Glonass, Resurs-P, and Lotos-S payloads.
best_known_for: Modern Soyuz workhorse for ISS crew + cargo
